SCTASK4826582 / REQ4058086
Demand Title/Change request Title - Hello,

FYI this topic has been discussed with Kamlesh Kumar Choubey <kamleshkumar.choubey@se.com> and Morgane Couliou <morgane.couliou@non.se.com> on March 23 2026. If you have any question, please don't hesitate to ask me.

For reminder: Publication chain for 3D & 360 assets publication:
Offer DAM -> Apigee -> EMH -> 3D Platform API.

Business justification:
Currently, DCES (3D model API) receives 3D & 360 assets from DAM and stores them indefinitely. 
Even when they are set obsolete in DAM, & a deletion message is sent, it’s not deleted from DCES.
This is because currently, EMH is only sending events of type "publish" for 3D & 360 assets, to 3D Platform API.

Statement of need:
We would like EMH to send "delete" events as well, once they receive it from DAM.
This will ensure that once the asset is set Obsolete in Offer DAM, it's removed from 3D Platform API.
Note: only 3D & 360 assets are concerned. Other asset types are not concerned.

Documentation:
The documentation on 3D Model API is provided by Morgane: https://confluence.se.com/x/i4wCJQ
 
Goal: once DAM sends a message where "docType"="3D Model" OR “360 set of image", and “action” = “DELETE”, it should trigger deletion 3D Platform API like below
(Example of deletion request of an asset with "Reference" = "mydocref" for SQE environment)
 
curl -X 'DELETE' \
  'https://visuals-contrib-sqe.schneider-electric.com/api/v1/3d/mydocref' \
  -H 'accept: application/json'
 
curl -X 'DELETE' \
  'https://visuals-contrib-sqe.schneider-electric.com/api/v1/360/mydocref' \
  -H 'accept: application/json'

Thanks & Regards
Anastasia,

comments.body: The meeting is scheduled on August 20th.

The meeting done today among Kamlesh and requestor.

The requirement is clear to the team. Estimated effort will be 5 days for development + unit testing.
The efforts estimation details have been shared to Anastasia and Jordi via email.
Approval from requestors is pending. As soon as team gets it, development will be started next week.

[^RE_ INTSOL-60499, Implement Deelete Flow to 3D Model API, Estimation Approval Request (2).msg]
We have received the estimation approval. Requirement has been discussed and finalized with @Anastasia. As a part of this change we are going to delete the assets when
"docType"="3D Model" OR “360 set of image", and “action” = “DELETE”. This change will be done in dam-asset-processor. 
Start date : 14 Sep and will be completed by end of next week.
